_about: Public-domain Stephen Higginson Tyng (1800-1885), evangelical Episcopal rector of St. George's, New York, for the Word Hoard: Memoir of Gregory T. Bedell (1836), Sermons preached in the Church of the Epiphany (1839), Lectures on the Law and the Gospel (1844), The Israel of God (1849), Christ is All (1849), Christian Titles (1853), Lessons on the Acts (1853), The Rich Kinsman (1855), The Captive Orphan (1860), Forty Years' Experience in Sunday-Schools (1860) and The Office and Duty of a Christian Pastor (1874), from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 55 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
